description: A certificate's field order (#249): the reference orders the names by localeCompare under Node's default collation (Certificate.ts:282), which gives a_b, a0, age, éa, f, Name where UTF-8 byte order gives Name, a0, a_b, age, f, éa; this crate verifies a binary certificate over the unsigned prefix as received and signs in the reference's order
reference: @bsv/sdk at ts-stack@edf6e03 (packages/sdk, bundled with bun build), run under Node v22.18.0 (ICU 77.1, locale en-US) by tests/support/certificate_field_order_249.mjs

witnesses.name: reference_signed_mixed_names
witnesses.origin: signed by the reference's Certificate.sign (certifier key 21, subject key 23, type 32 x 0x06, serial 32 x 0x07, no revocation outpoint, six fields Name, a_b, age, a0, éa, f, each the base64 text of "v-<name>")

witnesses.name: byte_order_signed_mixed_names
witnesses.origin: the same certificate, the names written in UTF-8 byte order and the preimage signed by the reference's ProtoWallet.createSignature under protocol [2, "certificate signature"] and key ID "<type> <serial>" (an issuer that sorts by bytes, as this crate did until #249); the reference's fromBinary(...).verify() re-sorts and refuses it, this crate verifies the bytes received

witnesses.name: repeated_field_name
witnesses.origin: the certificate's prefix with two fields named x, unsigned; the reference's fromBinary refuses it (Certificate.ts:374)
